subject: اللغة الإنجليزية
lesson: Unit 1: New Media – Reading and Understanding
outcomes: Read the article 'Screenagers' for gist and for detail.
Guess the meaning of new words from context.
Give my opinion about screen time with a reason and an example.

tf.why: Yes! Two words join to make one new word.

tf.s: According to the article, teenagers spend about nine hours a day online.
tf.why: Correct, the article says nine hours.

tf.s: The article says excessive screen time is negative regardless of content.
tf.why: The article says content and context matter more than the amount of time.

tf.s: YouTube is the most popular platform for this age group in the article.
tf.why: Well done, the article names YouTube.

tf.s: The article says all video games contain violent content.
tf.why: Not all video games are violent; content and context matter.

tf.s: 'Attention span' is a type of video.
tf.why: It is the length of time you can concentrate.

tf.s: Skimming means reading a text quickly to get the general idea.
tf.why: Right, you focus on key words to get the gist.

tf.s: 'Reluctant' means happy and quick to do something.
tf.why: 'Reluctant' means unwilling and slow to do something.

tf.s: Too much screen time can harm the brain's development.
tf.why: Yes, the article warns about this.

tf.s: Skimming means reading every word slowly to find small details.
tf.why: That is reading for detail; skimming is quick reading for gist.

o: a teenager who spends a lot of time in front of a screen
boxes.why: It is an informal word: screen + teenager.

boxes.q: A person who uses a phone too much is ___ it.
boxes.why: 'Addicted to' means you cannot stop using it.
Excessive screen time means too much screen time.

boxes.q: Teenagers who are always on their phones are ___ their phones.
boxes.why: 'Glued to' means you cannot look away from something.

boxes.q: Which matters more, says the writer?
boxes.why: What you watch and why matters more than how long.

boxes.q: Many ___ use social media to advertise products.
boxes.why: Brands are companies that sell products.

boxes.q: You can ___ videos to watch later without Internet.
boxes.why: When you download, the video is saved on your device.
'In my opinion' introduces what you think.

o: people who grew up with digital technology
people who never use the Internet
boxes.why: Today's teenagers grew up with screens around them.

boxes.q: Which word means 'results of an action'?
boxes.why: Consequences are what happens because of an action.

hunt.q: Hours a day teens spend online
Most popular platform in the article
Unwilling and slow to do something
Reading quickly for the general idea
Save a video on your device

mcq.q: According to the article, how many hours a day do teenagers spend online?
mcq.why: The article says nine hours a day.

mcq.q: Which statement is NOT true according to the article?
o: Excessive screen time is negative regardless of content.
Many teenagers are addicted to smartphones.
Content and context of screen use matter.
Too much screen time can harm the brain.
mcq.why: The writer says useful content is not negative.

o: the length of time you can concentrate
mcq.why: It is how long you can focus on one thing.

mcq.q: Which word means 'unwilling and slow to do something'?
mcq.why: A reluctant person does not want to do it.

o: Excessive screen time can make me tired.
I am excessive to my phone.
My phone is excessive of games.
mcq.why: 'Excessive' is an adjective that means too much.

mcq.q: Sara can't stop looking at her phone during dinner. She is ...
mcq.why: 'Glued to' means always looking at something.

mcq.q: You want to know the general idea of five texts quickly. What should you do?
mcq.why: Skimming helps you get the gist fast.

mcq.q: Why does the writer think screen time is not always negative?
o: Useful content can help teenagers learn.
mcq.why: Content and context matter more than hours.

mcq.q: Which opinion is best supported with a reason?
o: In my opinion, screen time is fine if the content is useful, because I learn new things.
mcq.why: A good opinion gives a clear idea and a reason.

mcq.q: How can you guess the meaning of a new word in a text?
mcq.why: The context around a word gives clues to its meaning.
